records.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
records.description: The agent that grows with you
records.author: NousResearch
records.limitations: Runtime solicitado, perfiles y skills nativas multiplataforma; validación financiera adicional local.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: msitarzewski/agency-agents
records.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
records.author: msitarzewski
records.limitations: Finance Tracker orientado a presupuesto interno, incluye lenguaje STRONG BUY y memoria financiera no apropiados al objetivo; adaptar sin copiar.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: dgunning/edgartools
records.description: Read and analyze SEC EDGAR filings in Python. 10-K, 8-K, XBRL financials, Form 3/4/5, 13F, ADV — clean API, well-typed, MIT-licensed.
records.author: dgunning
records.limitations: Buen ajuste SEC y tipado; exige identificación SEC y acceso a sus dominios. No valida automáticamente originales; instalación diferida.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: Arelle/Arelle
records.author: Arelle
records.limitations: Validación XBRL amplia, pero mayor complejidad/taxonomías. LICENSE.md Apache-2.0 aunque API dice NOASSERTION.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: sec-edgar/sec-edgar
records.description: Download all companies  periodic reports, filings and forms from EDGAR database.
records.author: sec-edgar
records.limitations: Descarga, no normaliza estados ni valúa; actividad observada menor; respetar fair access SEC.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: py-pdf/pypdf
records.description: A pure-python PDF library capable of splitting, merging, cropping, and transforming the pages of PDF files
records.author: py-pdf
records.limitations: Texto y manipulación PDF sin OCR. Licencia BSD-3-Clause revisada en LICENSE; API NOASSERTION.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: jsvine/pdfplumber
records.description: Plumb a PDF for detailed information about each char, rectangle, line, et cetera — and easily extract text and tables.
records.author: jsvine
records.limitations: Extracción de tablas/texto; depende de pdfminer.six y pypdfium2; cotejo visual obligatorio en documentos complejos.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: pymupdf/PyMuPDF
records.description: PyMuPDF is a high performance Python library for data extraction, analysis, conversion & manipulation of PDF (and other) documents.
records.author: pymupdf
records.limitations: Rápido y con renderizado; AGPL-3.0/comercial y dependencia nativa; innecesario para la prueba actual.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: jmcnamara/XlsxWriter
records.description: A Python module for creating Excel XLSX files.
records.author: jmcnamara
records.limitations: Genera fórmulas con caches; no recalcula ni edita libros existentes. Complementar con openpyxl y LibreOffice/Excel.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: ClosedXML/ClosedXML
records.description: ClosedXML is a .NET library for reading, manipulating and writing Excel 2007+ (.xlsx, .xlsm) files. It aims to provide an intuitive and user-friendly interface to dealing with the underlying OpenXML API.
records.author: ClosedXML
records.limitations: Buen soporte Excel, pero agrega runtime .NET y complejidad a Hermes/Python; API advierte cambios.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.name: JerBouma/FinanceToolkit
records.author: JerBouma
records.limitations: DCF/FCFF/FCFE transparentes, pandas/numpy y fuentes externas; motor propio acotado para inputs explícitos y revisión independiente.
records.validation: Preselection by implementer. CEO review and live capability evidence remain required.

records.author: Anthropic
records.limitations: Official methodology includes Office JS/MCP/recalc.py and repeated user confirmation. Local independent skill preserves formulas/QA principles, uses Hermes/ares and the user's authorized autonomy. Do not install Claude-only runtime. Also reviewed 3-statement-model and model-builder/audit-xls.
